# P37.12 — Keyed US 511 target wiring after key registration (D-SOURCES.7-2)

Manifest row 433 · `docs/tickets/433_P37.12__keyed-us-511-wiring.md` · Round 11 / P37 (11D) · D-SOURCES.7-2
Harness: devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent · Base: `r11/P37.11-sam-gov-sweep-resume`

## What

The D-SOURCES.7-2 engineering half — the ten keyed US 511 camera APIs
(graduated from `[[enumerated]]`, ADR-237):

- **Ten keyed `[[targets]]`** — fl511_api, 511ny_api, az511_api, nvroads_api,
  ohgo_api, 511pa, 511wi, 511alaska, ctroads, newengland511 — under two new
  declared-contract kinds: `iteris_511_rows` (the Iteris/IBI-511
  `api/v2/get/cameras` family) and `ohgo_511_cameras` (ODOT's ApiResult
  envelope). Each row carries `api_key_env` — the env-var NAME only; a
  credential literal is a registry defect (`KeyedSpecNotDeclared`,
  `sig-connectors validate` enforces it).
- **A wire-only credential seam** — `PoliteFetcher.fetch` gains `auth_param`:
  the Iteris `?key=` reaches the transport but never a recorded surface
  (`per_fetch`, `conduct_decisions`, robots verdicts, `FetchResult.url` → the
  capture `source_uri`). OHGO's key rides the documented
  `Authorization: APIKEY` header — no credential in any URL at all.
- **An unprovisioned key is a recorded refusal** — `KeyNotProvisioned` before
  any egress (incl. the robots probe), landing on `report.refusals` like the
  rights refusals — completion `partial`, never a fabricated fetch or a fake
  disappearance.
- **Strict declared contracts** — no keyed payload was ever observed (every
  2026-09-17 probe answered `Invalid Key`/401), so the parse is fail-closed
  on the published contract: a non-array/error-envelope/shell response or a
  truncated ApiResult page is `ContentDrift`, never a partial or guessed
  registry.
- **The surrounding wiring** — ten gated `dot_511_*` source rows (600
  registered; every row `ingestion_permitted=false`), `api_host` allowlist
  entries, the AK/CT/NV/OH/WI `us.state_abbr` detector extents, vocab
  `2026.11.07` (`Views`/`CameraViews`/`Links`/`Href` media names
  recorded-excluded; `DirectionOfTravel` alias), ten **paused** cadence
  seats declaring the `SIG_US511_*_KEY` → `sig-us511-*-key` Secret-Manager
  bindings OP-13 fills.
